core: Plasma membrane lipid asymmetry and protein targeting
qualifier: phospholipid flipping/scrambling with apical, raft and CFTR trafficking
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid translocation and apical-raft protein targeting
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane organisation: flippase/scramblase lipid translocation, blebbing, repair and volume control plus apical/basolateral, raft and CFTR protein delivery; the lipid-translocation side separates it from epithelial/bile confusables and the apical-raft targeting separates it from the apoptotic PS-exposure confusable.

qualifier: arginine, ornithine and citrulline metabolism and transport
name: Urea cycle and arginine-ornithine metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover urea cycle enzymes and their deficiencies, ammonium handling, and arginine/ornithine/citrulline/lysine synthesis and transport, whereas confusables centre on glutamate, glutamine, proline and aspartate metabolism.

qualifier: Gi/Gz-coupled alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition
name: Adenylate cyclase regulation by Gi/z-coupled alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of adenylate cyclase and cAMP production, with emphasis on inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic signalling, unlike confusables centred on cAMP/PKA effectors, cholinergic/purinergic receptors or catecholamine secretion.

qualifier: kynurenine route to NAD+
name: Polyamine metabolism and tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ biosynthesis
rationale: Members split between polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport and tryptophan-kynurenine-nicotinate routes to NAD+; the polyamine arm distinguishes it from NAD/redox confusables and the kynurenine-NAD+ arm from methionine salvage and hypusine confusables.

qualifier: with tRNA processing and modification
name: Mitochondrial genome expression and tRNA processing and modification
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing, translation and ribosome assembly together with nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA maturation and modification, which confusables (cytosolic rRNA modification, peptidyl modifications, readthrough) lack.

qualifier: ventricular myocardial wall morphogenesis and regeneration
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth and myocardial wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy, survival and regeneration and trabecular/compact ventricular myocardium formation, while confusables centre on septum, endocardium and early heart-field specification.

qualifier: HSF1-driven chaperone protein refolding
name: HSF1 heat shock response and chaperone-mediated protein refolding
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation and chaperone refolding (including ER and mitochondrial protein-folding stress), distinguishing it from de novo folding, stress granule and ER UPR confusables.

qualifier: angiogenic growth factor production and pro-angiogenic regulation
name: Angiogenic growth factor production and sprouting angiogenesis promotion
rationale: Members concern VEGF/FGF/TGF-beta2 production and positive regulation of endothelial proliferation, migration and vessel branching, unlike confusables centred on anti-angiogenic regulation, VEGFR/Tie receptor signalling or leukocyte-endothelial adhesion.

qualifier: nephric duct and ureter formation with restraint of kidney growth
name: Nephric duct and ureter development and kidney size restraint
rationale: Members cover nephric duct, ureter, mesonephros and metanephros development with negative control of kidney cell proliferation and mesenchymal apoptosis, unlike confusables focused on ureteric bud branching or metanephric nephron differentiation.

qualifier: monocyte/dendritic cell markers and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface markers, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are mostly monocyte, dendritic cell and other leukocyte surface signatures plus CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation, distinguishing them from MHC class II peptide presentation, neutrophil and T cell activation confusables.

name: Defective glycosaminoglycan linker tetrasaccharide synthesis
rationale: All three members are disorders of B4GALT7, B3GALT6 and B3GAT3, enzymes building the shared GAG-protein linker tetrasaccharide, unlike confusables about heparan, keratan or chondroitin chain-specific synthesis.

qualifier: reuptake transport and MAO/COMT catabolism
name: Catecholamine reuptake and monoamine oxidative catabolism
rationale: Members concern dopamine/norepinephrine reuptake transporters and MAO/COMT degradation of biogenic amines, unlike confusables focused on serotonin synthesis or catecholamine synthesis and vesicular release.

qualifier: ribosome quality control and stress granules
name: Ribosome-associated quality control and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover stalled-ribosome rescue and nascent-chain degradation plus stress granule assembly and disassembly, distinguishing it from ERAD, aggrephagy and general proteasomal degradation confusables.

qualifier: chamber formation and septation from heart tube and second heart field
name: Embryonic heart chamber formation and cardiac septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern heart tube patterning, second heart field, ventricle formation and atrial/ventricular septum morphogenesis, while confusables centre on conduction system, trabeculation, valves, outflow tract or coronary vessels.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, gp130 and IL-12/IL-10 family cytokines
name: Interleukin and gp130-family cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-6/LIF/CNTF, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10/20 and IL-3/5 cytokines through STAT and SHC/ERK, distinguishing them from interferon-centred confusables.

qualifier: promotion of pituitary gonadotropin secretion
name: Activin signaling regulation and gonadotropin secretion
rationale: Members concern activin signalling and its modulation by follistatin and TGFBR3 together with FSH/LH release, unlike confusables about other TGFBR3 ligands or gonadal development.

qualifier: KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR with inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT/FLT3/PDGFR/ALK/FGFR mutants and kinase inhibitor resistance
rationale: Members are cancer mutants, fusions and amplifications of KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK/LTK and FGFR and their TKI binding or resistance, distinguishing them from ERBB2 mutant and normal EPO/FLT3 signalling confusables.

qualifier: VEGF receptor and Tie2 signalling, positive and negative control
name: VEGF receptor and Tie2 signaling in sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members cover VEGF-VEGFR/neuropilin and Tie2 signalling with both positive and negative regulation of endothelial sprouting, proliferation and migration, unlike confusables about endothelial junctions, differentiation or leukocyte adhesion.

qualifier: COPI/COPII, Rab and ARF GTPase regulation and Golgi organization
name: Golgi vesicle trafficking and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
rationale: Members cover ER-Golgi, intra-Golgi, Golgi-endosome-lysosome transport, Golgi assembly and Rab/ARF regulators, while confusables centre on ER protein targeting, insertion, folding and ERAD.

qualifier: agglutination, cytolysis and metal sequestration
name: Mucosal antibacterial defense via agglutination, cytolysis and metal sequestration
rationale: Members concern innate mucosal responses to bacteria (attachment, agglutination, cytolysis, nutrient-metal sequestration, Gram-positive defence), unlike confusables built on defensins and antifungal or antinematode responses.

qualifier: including Wnt/calcium non-canonical branch
name: Frizzled-Dishevelled Wnt signaling including Wnt/calcium pathway
rationale: Members concern receptor-proximal Wnt events (DVL activation and degradation, AXIN recruitment, ligand antagonists, LRP5) spanning canonical and Wnt/Ca2+ branches, unlike confusables on Wnt secretion, RNF43/FZD ubiquitination or AXIN degradation.

qualifier: sensory, vocal and social behaviour
name: MECP2 transcriptional regulation and sensorimotor and social behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 regulation and Rett-associated loss-of-function events with vocal, social, sensory and sensorimotor-gating behaviours and striatum/amygdala development, unlike confusables centred on locomotion or glycinergic transmission.

qualifier: BH3-only protein activation and BAX/BAK
name: BH3-only activation and BAX/BAK mitochondrial apoptosis initiation
rationale: Members concern activation of BH3-only proteins (BIM, BAD, BMF, NOXA, PUMA) and BAX/BAK oligomerisation driving cytochrome c release, unlike confusables on p53 transcription, apoptosome and caspase activation.

qualifier: phenotypic switching and SRF-driven cytoskeletal programmes
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and SRF cytoskeletal programs
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, differentiation, apoptosis and phenotypic switching with SRF-target actin/contraction modules, unlike shear-stress endothelial and cardiac muscle confusables.

qualifier: CSF1 receptor and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signalling
name: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling in macrophage proliferation and fusion
rationale: Members concern M-CSF/CSF1R and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signalling controlling macrophage proliferation and fusion, unlike confusables about osteoclasts, SIRP interactions or myeloid differentiation.
